name: 보안모드 침입 감지
purpose: While the space is armed and someone is present, give the occupant a spoken grace window to disarm; if the grace expires, alert with evidence (video by email) at most once per cooldown.

features.alerting: grace-then-alert state machine over armed∧occupied (core purpose)
features.voice_notice: spoken disarm instruction at grace start (advisory)
features.evidence: video capture attached to the alert email (enhancing)

roles.purpose: Whether security mode is on ('보안 모드 자동 제어' produces it).
roles.note: Without the armed flag the scenario would alert on every entry — the (f) 사례 of the fault model. Free input under the GV lock.

roles.purpose: Presence aggregate that starts the grace window.
Reach the owner when intrusion is suspected — the scenario's reason to exist.
roles.note: Essential unlike the air-quality toast: an intrusion scenario that cannot alert anyone is purpose-dead, not degraded.

roles.purpose: Tell the person in the room how to disarm during grace.
roles.note: Dropping it shortens the courtesy, not the protection; the toast still explains disarm.

roles.purpose: Capture footage for the alert email.
roles.note: The email consumes the captured video (bind variable), so dropping the camera forces the email into the same cone — the one case where a dropped role's cone crosses another role's call. plan_drop must escalate here, and the degrade needs a *replacement* email call (SendMail without attachment) = an InsertBefore/ReplaceMember design decision, not a pure deletion.

roles.purpose: Deliver the evidence out of the home.

contracts.statement: No alert, speech, capture or email unless armed AND occupied.
The alert fires only after grace_sec of continuous armed∧occupied.
Alerts are at least alert_cooldown apart.
The spoken notice happens exactly once per grace window (grace_start seed).
Leaving armed∧occupied resets the grace window.
grace_sec > period and alert_cooldown > grace_sec, so the state machine can actually traverse its states.

validity.note: 4 device-ish roles (ALERT_SINK, VOICE_NOTICE, EVIDENCE_SOURCE, EVIDENCE_SINK) + 2 GV + clock — the '침입감지 4-role' contingency prototype target.
